liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): The Franklin's Tower into Estimated Prophet into Terrapin Station run made the reviewer cheer; Franklin's Tower derails slightly at the start, but the band finds the groove and finishes strongly [11][17]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): A flash during Estimated Prophet remained vivid in the reviewer's memory; A fire ball during Estimated Prophet was classic [12][16]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): The jam coming out of Estimated Prophet leads into Terrapin Station; Terrapin Station is especially nice, with a lengthy jam [16][17]
- **Aiko-Aiko** (1 review): Jerry experiments with MIDI during the opening Iko Iko; Vince takes a short keyboard solo during the opening Iko Iko [19]
- **Althea** (1 review): The reviewer feels the show really starts to get going around Althea [14]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): The second set opens with Help, Slipknot, Franklin's, where the reviewer says the fun begins [22]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): The band emerges from Space with a thunderous introduction to All Along The Watchtower [16]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): The reviewer singles out a stellar Stella Blue, along with the Help on the Way, Slipknot, Franklin's run [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-10.akg568.unknown.nawrocki.15389.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd94-10-10.sbd.wiley.14198.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 166 min; rated 3.64/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound was patchy and hit-or-miss where the reviewer was dancing in the arena [21]
- **gd1994-10-10.sbd.miller.34563.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 165 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd94-10-10.schoeps.wiley.8042.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording where a loud whooping neighbor sits very close to the mics, suggesting the taper was outside the tapers' section [18]
- **gd1994-10-10.akg460.mcminn.sobel.88861.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- A British couple traveled to the US for the first two USAir nights; they lost their rental car in the lot the night before [20]
- The reviewer brought a friend, Coz, who was seeing Jerry live on stage for the first time [21]
- During Estimated Prophet, someone on the floor threw up a large ball of lit flash paper at the 'fire wheel' lyric [22]
- First set seemed average and slow to the reviewer; the second set picked up with strong jams [11]
- Second set had high energy for 1994 and some special moments [12]
- Having attended all three 1994 Landover shows, the reviewer rates this one the best, though the first set starts slowly [17]
- This was the middle of three Landover nights; the band seemed to go through the motions early on [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-10.akg568.unknown.nawrocki.15389.shnf**: taped by Source discs kindly provided by Dave DiMartino; transferred by Doug Nawrocki; source: AKG 568's > DAT > CDR > EAC* > CDWave > mkwACT [1]. Also: Updated seed: a dropout in Desolation Row from 2:32 to 2:35 was patched using a circulating soundboard source [1]
- **gd94-10-10.sbd.wiley.14198.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard lineage runs through two DAT generations, a hi-fi VHS tape, another DAT, and Delta Dio2496 to seekable SHN; Patched with a Schoeps MK4 audience source, via Rob Harrison; seeded to etree by T. Wiley [2]
- **gd1994-10-10.sbd.miller.34563.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> ? -> 3rd Gen Cassette D [3]. Also: Schoeps MK4 recording taken from DAT to CD; the transition between discs 2 and 3 is seamless [3]
- **gd94-10-10.schoeps.wiley.8042.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Tim Wiley; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [4]
- **gd1994-10-10.akg460.mcminn.sobel.88861.flac16**: taped by Tom McMinn; transferred by Jason Sobel; source: AKG 460B/ck61 > custom pre-amp > Teac DA-P20 (@ 48 kHz) [5]. Also: The original DAT was recorded with pre-emphasis, so it was de-emphasized with the Waves Q10 equalizer plug-in; Original 48 kHz wav files from the DAT transfer are archived and available on request [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-10-11 USAir Arena, Landover, MD, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-10-11-usair-arena-landover-md-usa/) [24]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1994-10-10 Mon USAir Arena, Landover, MD](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1312018473329/grateful-dead-1994-10-10-mon-usair-arena) [25]
